description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {C}{C}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and goading it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
